cases.current_observation: The local runner executes Trend, Stock, sales-market-agent, new-product-agent in order and retains request_id in each stage.
assertions: all four stage records use SYN-REQ-001
raw producer results remain available
no public wire schema is inferred
status and limitations are preserved
no missing value is changed to zero
decision_needed: whether each downstream stage supports each partial input

assertions: no_results is not represented as quantity zero
observed zero keeps unit, as_of and Evidence
domain status and errors are distinct from HTTP failure
continuation outcome is controlled by stage policy
decision_needed: whether Stock, sales-market-agent and new-product-agent can each consume Trend error

assertions: error result is preserved
no product or inventory fact is fabricated
decision_needed: whether sales-market-agent and new-product-agent accept Stock error

assertions: raw sales-market-agent error payload is preserved
new-product-agent does not treat it as sales/market evidence
decision_needed: whether new-product-agent should create a limited draft from remaining valid inputs

assertions: source versions remain unchanged
current new-product-agent compatibility error is surfaced before its HTTP call
decision_needed: new-product-agent direct support, explicit adapter, normalized internal version, or versioned compatibility route

assertions: reject inconsistent envelope/body before unwrapping
preserve earlier valid stage records
validate route and producer identity as separately defined values
decision_needed: approve route ID and response producer ID mapping

assertions: sales-market-agent envelope is validated
result body passed to new-product-agent is unchanged
execution trace retains full sales-market-agent envelope and result
decision_needed: whether sales-market-agent output version 1.3-proposal is accepted for any shared interface

planning_request.query: synthetic request with no structured market/channel

assertions: do not silently claim market/channel were user requested
record unresolved scope before sales-market-agent call or result interpretation
decision_needed: use a producer default, pass null, ask user, or skip sales-market-agent

assertions: do not collapse multiple values into one without a rule
preserve original scope and mark unsupported mapping
decision_needed: producer supports lists, orchestrator splits calls, or user clarification

assertions: domain result may be continued only per approved stage policy
transport failure is not wrapped as a successful producer result
decision_needed: approved HTTP status and error body mapping

assertions: configuration_complete reports configuration presence
known schema blocker prevents ready
neither property claims live health
decision_needed: required schema/health checks for production readiness

assertions: candidate run fingerprint is stable for identical fixture/config
request retry deduplication is not implied
decision_needed: whether deterministic run_id and persistent idempotency are needed
